findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：Vicor 成長取決於 OEM/ODM 開發新產品的步調、對 Advanced Products 的接受度與客戶產品成功；未提及第二供應商或自製的具體事件。
findings.excerpt: Our growth is therefore dependent on: the pace at which these OEMs and ODMs develop their own new products; the acceptance of our Advanced Products by these OEMs and ODMs; and the success of the customers’ products incorporating our Advanced Products.

findings.claim: 管理層稱競爭者仿製第一代 VPD 方案、且有專利與供應連續性風險；首要運算客戶處於晶圓級引擎陡峭量產爬坡，第二代 VPD 其他客戶接洽待其轉換之後（公司自述）。
findings.source: MarketBeat Vicor Q2 2026 earnings call highlights
